headline: Review of complaints, financial report, and possible executive session on old and new business.
summary: The agenda includes a secretary and financial report and a review of complaints. It also lists an executive session, if the town attorney recommends one, followed by old and new business.
items: Review of complaints and status of complaints
Executive session, if recommended by the town attorney
location: Second Floor Conference Room, Hamden Government Center, 2750 Dixwell Avenue, Hamden, CT 06518

Meeting Agenda: The Hamden Plains Cemetery Committee, Town of Hamden, will hold 
a Regular Meeting on Tuesday, November 10, 2026 at 4:00 PM in person at the Hamden 
Government Center, Second Floor Conference Room.  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
 
2. ATTENDANCE 
 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
 
4. SECRETARY / FINANCIAL REPORT 
 
5. REVIEW OF COMPLAINTS AND STATUS OF COMPLAINTS 
 
6. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney) 
7. OLD BUSINESS 
 
8. NEW BUSINESS 
 
9. ADJOURNMENT 
 
  
NOTE: The public may address any item on the agenda of a regular or special meeting and any 
matter within the purview of a Board or Commission at a regular meeting either electronically or 
in person, unless otherwise set forth or constrained by Law of the provisions of this Charter.
